thread:
hope_marketing: Final check for Thursday announcement (publish 09:15 PT). Need: 1-line headline, single benchmark stat for the hero, final docs URL, rollout start time, and sales tag confirmation. @dan_engineering @rachel_docs @evan_salesops

dan_engineering: Rollout plan OK: start 08:30 PT with 5% canary for 10m, 30% for 15m, then full by 09:15 PT if healthy. We'll pause on error rate >0.6% or p95 regression >25%.

rachel_docs: Docs final: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-4. Changelog + migration note: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-4/changelog. Added short snippet for users to opt-in to the new quantized kernels:
```
{"inference": {"quantization": "enabled", "profile": "compact-2"}}
```

brand_manager: Headline suggestion: "v2.4: faster inference, lower token costs". Short stat for hero: "up to 28% token cost reduction on common chat workloads". Need perf PNG for blog cover.

evan_salesops: Sales routing: web form will tag inbound leads with "v2_4_launch" and route to AE queue. I'll run a quick post-send test. No issues from my side.

ci-bot: Release pipeline triggered by dan_engineering at 1900012400. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/54678 :gear:

hope_marketing: Plan: send at 09:15 PT with docs + changelog, hero image, and webinar CTA (Mon 11am PT). We'll use the headline and the "up to 28%" stat. Ev and Dan will confirm lead tagging and rollout status here.

dan_engineering: Canary 5% stable at 08:40 PT, moving to 30% at 08:50 PT. No visible regressions.

ci-bot: Release completed at 1900012460. Status: success. Full rollout done.

evan_salesops: Confirmed after-send test: leads are tagged "v2_4_launch" and routing OK.

hope_marketing: LIVE  announcement sent at 09:15 PT. Thanks team! :tada:
